result.summary: Found 3 major visual issues: restaurant names and cards are truncated or cut off in multiple sections due to layout overflow problems.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' in the 'Fastest near you' section is truncated and doesn't show the full name
issues.suggestion: Adjust text truncation rules or increase card width to display complete restaurant names, or implement proper text wrapping

issues.description: The third restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' section is partially cut off at the right edge of the screen
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scroll container properly displays all cards without cutting them off, or adjust the card width and spacing for the viewport

issues.description: The second restaurant card in 'Popular right now' section is cut off at the bottom, hiding the restaurant name and delivery details
issues.suggestion: Increase the scroll area height or adjust vertical spacing to ensure all content is visible, or add better scroll indication
